```{r}
# Load RIDER and your Delta dataset 
rider <- read.csv("FINAL_RIDER_FEATURES_COMBINED.csv")

x_delta <- read.csv("PDL1_DELTA_ABS_CONCATENATED.csv")

#ensure names match up between features (get rid abs name from feature name bit here)
names(x_delta) <- trimws(names(x_delta))
names(rider) <- trimws(names(rider))
names(x_delta) <- gsub("_abs_", "_", names(x_delta))

# Identify features common to both RIDER and the main dataset 
feats <- intersect(
  setdiff(names(rider), c("Patient_Num", "Timepoint", "His")),
  setdiff(names(x_delta), c("Patient_Num", "His"))
)

#Split RIDER into pre/post scans
pre  <- rider[rider$Timepoint == "pre",  ]
post <- rider[rider$Timepoint == "post", ]

#Calculate ICC
icc_vals <- sapply(feats, function(f) {
  m <- merge(pre[c("Patient_Num", f)], post[c("Patient_Num", f)], by = "Patient_Num")
  # Return NA if no common patients are found
  if(nrow(m) < 2) return(NA)
  icc(m[, 2:3], model = "twoway", type = "agreement")$value
})

# 5. Keep only reproducible features 
reproducible_feats <- names(icc_vals[!is.na(icc_vals) & icc_vals >= 0.8])

message(glue("Retained {length(reproducible_feats)} features out of {length(feats)} tested."))

# 6. Update dataset x_delta, include outcome (his) and patient id
cols_to_keep <- c("Patient_Num", "His", reproducible_feats)
# Check which columns actually exist 
valid_cols <- cols_to_keep[cols_to_keep %in% names(x_delta)]
x_delta <- x_delta[, valid_cols]

message(glue("Dataset 'x_delta' has been updated. New column count: {ncol(x_delta)}"))
saveRDS(reproducible_feats, "reproducible_feats.rds")
write.csv(x_delta, "x_icc_filtered_absolute.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
### SPLIT DATA INTO TRAINING AND EXTERNAL VALIDATION 
set.seed(43)
split_idx = sample.split(x_delta$His, SplitRatio = 0.8)
train_set_full <- subset(x_delta, split_idx == T)
val_set_full <- subset(x_delta, split_idx == F)
train_set_full <- as.data.frame(train_set_full)
val_set_full <- as.data.frame(val_set_full)
     
```

```{r}
r_train_mean <- colMeans(train_set_full[, 3:ncol(train_set_full)], na.rm = TRUE)
r_train_std  <- sapply(train_set_full[, 3:ncol(train_set_full)], sd, na.rm = TRUE)

r_scaled_train <- as.data.frame(scale(train_set_full[, 3:ncol(train_set_full)],
                                       center = r_train_mean, scale = r_train_std))

r_scaled_val <- as.data.frame(scale(val_set_full[, 3:ncol(val_set_full)],
                                     center = r_train_mean, scale = r_train_std))
```

```{r}
x_pca_input <- as.matrix(r_scaled_train) # unsupervised methods, Here we are selecting just the input variables, not the outcome variable, as PCA is an unsupervised technique
```

```{r}
x_pca_input <- x_pca_input[ , which(apply(x_pca_input, 2, var) != 0)]
r_scaled_train <- r_scaled_train[ , which(apply(r_scaled_train, 2, var) != 0)]
```

```{r}
# Here we undertake principal component analysis for dimensionality reduction
prin_comp <- prcomp(x_pca_input, scale. = F)  
```

```{r}
# calculate the std deviation of the PCs and then compute the variance
std_dev <- prin_comp$sdev
pr_var <- std_dev^2
# compute the proportion of the variance explained by each PC
prop_varex <- pr_var/sum(pr_var)
# create a scree plot to look at how many PCs to select - "zoom" in to the first x number of PCs rather than looking at all
zoom <- prop_varex[1:50]
plot(zoom, xlab = "Principal Component",
             ylab = "Proportion of Variance Explained",
             type = "b")
# A cumulative scree plot also helps to visualize - this shows that the first ~X PCs explain approx 90% of the variance
plot(cumsum(zoom), xlab = "Principal Component",
              ylab = "Cumulative Proportion of Variance Explained",
              type = "b")
res.pca <- PCA(x_pca_input, graph = T, scale.unit = T, ncp = 5)
eig.val <- get_eigenvalue(res.pca)

fviz_eig(res.pca, addlabels = T, ylim = c(0,50))

vari <- get_pca_var(res.pca)

# Contributions of variables to PC1&2
fviz_contrib(res.pca, choice = "var", axes = 1:2, top = 100)
cumsum(prop_varex)[1:15]  # shows cumulative variance for first 15 PCs
train.pca<- as.data.frame(prin_comp$x)
train.pca<- train.pca[,1:8] # here account for 80% variance
train.pca$His <- train_set_full$His

val.pca <- as.data.frame(predict(prin_comp, newdata = r_scaled_val))
val.pca <- val.pca[,1:8] # same here account to 80% variance
val.pca$His <- val_set_full$His
```

```{r}

### NOW FOR THE SUPERVISED APPROACHES - FOR THIS WE FIRST REMOVE HIGHLY CORRELATED FEATURES AND APPLY THE FDR STEP

### Now to look at just the radiomic features and remove any that are highly correlated
cor_mat <- cor(r_scaled_train)
cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)] <- 0
diag(cor_mat) <- 0
# # Above two commands can be replaced with
#  cor_mat[!lower.tri(cor_mat)] <- 0
# #
filt_rad_train <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(r_scaled_train)[,!apply(cor_mat,2,function(z) any(z > 0.90))])
```

```{r}
head(filt_rad_train)
ncol(filt_rad_train)
filt_rad_train$His <- as.factor(train_set_full$His)

### Now we undertake the FDR step by taking the univariate LR for each variable in the training set. We extract the list of p-values and apply BH correction to account for multiple testing. Then we create a list of significant values (number of values differs according to how strict a p value threshold is used). This can take several minutes.
uni_reg = tbl_uvregression(
  data = filt_rad_train,
  method = glm,
  method.args = list(family = binomial),
  y = His
)

# 1. Extract the variable names and p-values from the regression results
res_sig <- uni_reg[["table_body"]][, c("variable", "p.value")]

# 2. Apply the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) correction to the p-values

res_sig$p_adjusted <- p.adjust(res_sig$p.value, method = "BH", n = length(res_sig$p.value))

# 3. Filter for significant features (p < 0.05)
# NOTE: this filters on the RAW p-value. To apply the BH correction properly,
# switch to: final <- subset(res_sig, p_adjusted < 0.05)
final <- subset(res_sig, p.value < 0.05)
uni_LR_variables <- final$variable

length(uni_LR_variables)
uni_LR_variables
```

```{r}
# Now we subset the training and validation sets to use the significant variables
names(r_scaled_val) <- make.names(names(r_scaled_val))

filt_rad_val <- as.data.frame(r_scaled_val[, uni_LR_variables])
```

```{r}
filt_rad_train <- filt_rad_train[, uni_LR_variables]
filt_rad_val <- as.data.frame(r_scaled_val[, uni_LR_variables])

filt_rad_train$His <- train_set_full$His
filt_rad_val$His <- val_set_full$His
# Convert the predictor features into a numeric matrix (x_train) and binarize the target outcomes into 1 (Responder) and 0 (Non-Responder) (y),

x_train <- as.matrix(filt_rad_train[, 1:(ncol(filt_rad_train)-1)]) 
y <- ifelse(filt_rad_train$His == "R", 1,
     ifelse(filt_rad_train$His == "NR", 0, NA))
y_val <- ifelse(val_set_full$His == "R", 1,
     ifelse(val_set_full$His == "NR", 0, NA))
x_train
```

```{r}
### Now we will perform a LASSO (10-fold cross validation on the training data)
set.seed(123)
fit_lasso <- glmnet(x_train, y, family="binomial", alpha=1, standardize=TRUE)
plot(fit_lasso, label=TRUE)
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y, family="binomial", alpha=1, standardize=TRUE)
fit_lasso <- glmnet(x_train, y, family="binomial", alpha=1, lambda=cv_lasso$lambda.min, standardize=TRUE)
plot(cv_lasso)
pred_lasso <- predict(fit_lasso, x_train)

coefs <- coef(fit_lasso, s='lambda.min') ### can change this to lambda.1se
inds <- which(coefs!=0)
sel_vars <- row.names(coefs)[inds]
Lasso.vars <- sel_vars[sel_vars %ni% '(Intercept)']
print(length(Lasso.vars))
Lasso.vars
```

```{r}
# Now we perform ELASTIC-NET (10-fold cross validation on the training data)
set.seed(123)
fit_enet <- glmnet(x_train, y, family="binomial", alpha=0.5, standardize=TRUE)
plot(fit_enet, label=TRUE)
cv_enet <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y, family="binomial", alpha=0.5, standardize=TRUE)
fit_enet <- glmnet(x_train, y, family="binomial", alpha=0.5, lambda=cv_enet$lambda.min, standardize=TRUE)
plot(cv_enet)
pred_enet <- predict(fit_enet, x_train)
coefs <- coef(fit_enet, s='lambda.min') ### can change this to lambda.1se
inds <- which(coefs!=0)
sel_vars <- row.names(coefs)[inds]
E.Net.vars <- sel_vars[sel_vars %ni% '(Intercept)']
print(length(E.Net.vars))
E.Net.vars
```

```{r}
### Recursive Feature Elimination
x_train <- as.data.frame(x_train)
y <- as.factor(y)

set.seed(321)
control <- rfeControl(functions = rfFuncs,
                      method = "repeatedcv",
                      repeats = 5,
                      number = 10)

result_rfe1 <- rfe(x_train, y, sizes = c(1:116), rfeControl = control)

result_rfe1
predictors(result_rfe1)
rfe.vars <- predictors(result_rfe1)

ggplot(data = result_rfe1, metric = "Accuracy") + theme_bw()
ggplot(data = result_rfe1, metric = "Kappa") + theme_bw()

varimp_data <- data.frame(feature = row.names(varImp(result_rfe1))[1:20],
                          importance = varImp(result_rfe1)[1:20, 1])

rfe_importance <- ggplot(data = varimp_data,
       aes(x = reorder(feature, importance), y = importance, fill = feature)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") + labs(x = "Features", y = "Variable Importance", title="Recursive Feature Elimination Results") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(importance, 2)), hjust = 1.2, color="black", size=3) +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

rfe_importance + coord_flip()
```

```{r}
pca = 'pca'
features_select <- list(p.vars, s.vars, k.vars, rownames(as.data.frame(mim.vars)), Lasso.vars, E.Net.vars, bor.vars, rfe.vars, pca)

# defined here so it exists before the training loop below uses it
fs_names <- c("p.vars", "s.vars", "k.vars", "mim.vars", "Lasso.vars",
              "E.Net.vars", "bor.vars", "rfe.vars", "pca")
```


```{r}
models_list <- list()
# pull all metrics together
get_metrics <- function(cm, prob, truth) {
  auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(response = truth, predictor = prob,
                                             levels = c("Neg","Pos"), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)))
  c(Sens = unname(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Spec = unname(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
    PPV  = unname(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
    NPV  = unname(cm$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]),
    F1   = unname(cm$byClass["F1"]),
    AUC  = auc_val)
}


res_list <- list()

for (i in features_select){
    
    if (identical(i, "pca")){ 
        rad_train3 <- train.pca
        rad_train3$His <- ifelse(train_set_full$His == "R", 1,
                           ifelse(train_set_full$His == "NR", 0, NA))
        
        rad_val3 <- val.pca
        rad_val3$His <- ifelse(val_set_full$His == "R", 1,
                         ifelse(val_set_full$His == "NR", 0, NA))
    } else {
        # Subset features securely
        temp_features <- filt_rad_train[ , i, drop = FALSE]
        rad_train3 <- cbind(temp_features, His = y)
        
        temp_val_features <- filt_rad_val[ , i, drop = FALSE]
        rad_val3 <- cbind(temp_val_features, His = val_set_full$His)
    }
    
    # 1. Validation Step 
    if (length(i) == 0 || ncol(rad_train3) < 2) {
        message("Skipping completely empty feature set.")
        next 
    }
    
    # Count features 
    n_features <- ncol(rad_train3) - 1

    synth_train <- ADASYN(rad_train3, perc_min = 50, k=5)
    rad_train3 <- synth_train
    
    rad_train3$His <- factor(rad_train3$His, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Neg", "Pos"))
    rad_val3$His   <- factor(y_val, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Neg", "Pos"))
    
    ### 1) GLM
    trctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 10, repeats = 3, classProbs = TRUE)
    set.seed(42)
    classifier_glm <- train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "glm",
                            family=binomial, trControl = trctrl, tuneLength = 20)
    glm_pred = factor(predict(classifier_glm, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
    cm_glm = confusionMatrix(glm_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
    glm_prob = predict(classifier_glm, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
    metrics_glm = get_metrics(cm_glm, glm_prob, rad_val3$His)
    
    ### 2) KNN
    set.seed(42)
    classifier_knn2 = train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "knn",
                            trControl=trctrl, tuneLength = 20)
    knn2_pred = factor(predict(classifier_knn2, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
    cm_knn2 = confusionMatrix(knn2_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
    knn2_prob = predict(classifier_knn2, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
    metrics_knn2 = get_metrics(cm_knn2, knn2_prob, rad_val3$His)
    
    ### 3) LINEAR SUPPORT VECTOR MACHINE
    set.seed(42)
    classifier_svm2 = train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "svmLinear",
                            trControl=trctrl, tuneLength = 20)
    svm_pred = factor(predict(classifier_svm2, newdata = rad_val3), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
    cm_svm2 = confusionMatrix(svm_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
    svm_prob = predict(classifier_svm2, newdata = rad_val3, type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
    metrics_svm2 = get_metrics(cm_svm2, svm_prob, rad_val3$His)
    
    ### 4) NAIVE BAYES CLASSIFIER
    set.seed(42)
    classifier_nb = train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "naive_bayes",
                          trControl=trctrl, tuneLength = 20)
    nb_pred = factor(predict(classifier_nb, newdata = rad_val3), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
    cm_nb = confusionMatrix(nb_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
    nb_prob = predict(classifier_nb, newdata = rad_val3, type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
    metrics_nb = get_metrics(cm_nb, nb_prob, rad_val3$His)
    
    ### 5) Random Forest  
    set.seed(42)
    if (n_features == 1) {
        tunegrid <- expand.grid(mtry = 1)
    } else {
        mtry_val <- max(1, floor(sqrt(n_features)))
        tunegrid <- expand.grid(mtry = unique(pmin(c(2, 3, mtry_val), n_features)))
    }
    classifier_rf = train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "rf",
                          trControl=trctrl, tuneGrid = tunegrid)
    rf_pred = factor(predict(classifier_rf, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
    cm_rf = confusionMatrix(rf_pred, reference = rad_val3$His, positive = "Pos") 
    rf_prob = predict(classifier_rf, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
    metrics_rf = get_metrics(cm_rf, rf_prob, rad_val3$His)
    
    ### 6) ARTIFICIAL NEURAL NETWORK
    set.seed(42)
    trctrl_nnet <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 1, repeats = 1, verboseIter = FALSE, classProbs = TRUE)
    classifier_nnet = train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "nnet", trace=FALSE,
                            trainControl = trctrl_nnet, tuneLength = 20, verboseIter=FALSE)
    nn_pred = factor(predict(classifier_nnet, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
    cm_nnet = confusionMatrix(nn_pred, as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
    nn_prob = predict(classifier_nnet, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
    metrics_nnet = get_metrics(cm_nnet, nn_prob, rad_val3$His)
    
    ### 8) PARTIAL LEAST SQUARES 
    set.seed(42)
    if (n_features == 1) {
        classifier_pls = train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "pls",
                               trainControl = trctrl, tuneGrid = expand.grid(ncomp = 1))
    } else {
        classifier_pls = train(form = His ~ ., data = rad_train3, method = "pls",
                               trainControl = trctrl, tuneLength = min(20, n_features))
    }
    pls_pred = factor(predict(classifier_pls, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
    cm_pls = confusionMatrix(pls_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
    pls_prob = predict(classifier_pls, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
    metrics_pls = get_metrics(cm_pls, pls_prob, rad_val3$His)
        
   ### 9) Ridge Regression
    if (n_features > 1) {
        lambda <- 10^seq(-3, 3, length = 100)
        set.seed(123)
        classifier_ridge <- train(His ~., data = rad_train3, method = "glmnet", family = "binomial",
                                  trControl = trctrl, tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 0, lambda = lambda))
        ridge_pred = factor(predict(classifier_ridge, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
        cm_ridge = confusionMatrix(ridge_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
        ridge_prob = predict(classifier_ridge, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
        metrics_ridge = get_metrics(cm_ridge, ridge_prob, rad_val3$His)
    } else {
        metrics_ridge <- c(Sens = NA, Spec = NA, PPV = NA, NPV = NA, F1 = NA, AUC = NA)
    }
    
    ### 10) LASSO Regression
    if (n_features > 1) {
        lambda <- 10^seq(-3, 3, length = 100)
        set.seed(123)
        classifier_lasso <- train(His ~., data = rad_train3, method = "glmnet", family = "binomial",
                                  trControl = trctrl, tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 1, lambda = lambda))
        lasso_pred = factor(predict(classifier_lasso, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
        cm_lasso = confusionMatrix(lasso_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos") 
        lasso_prob = predict(classifier_lasso, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
        metrics_lasso = get_metrics(cm_lasso, lasso_prob, rad_val3$His)
    } else {
        metrics_lasso <- c(Sens = NA, Spec = NA, PPV = NA, NPV = NA, F1 = NA, AUC = NA)
    }
    
    ### 11) Elastic Net Regression
    if (n_features > 1) {
        lambda <- 10^seq(-3, 3, length = 100)
        set.seed(123)
        classifier_elastic <- train(His ~., data = rad_train3, method = "glmnet",
                                    trControl = trctrl, tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 0.5, lambda = lambda))
        elastic_pred = factor(predict(classifier_elastic, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)]), levels = c("Neg","Pos"))
        cm_elastic = confusionMatrix(elastic_pred, reference = as.factor(rad_val3$His), positive = "Pos")
        elastic_prob = predict(classifier_elastic, newdata = rad_val3[-ncol(rad_val3)], type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
        metrics_elastic = get_metrics(cm_elastic, elastic_prob, rad_val3$His)
    } else {
        metrics_elastic <- c(Sens = NA, Spec = NA, PPV = NA, NPV = NA, F1 = NA, AUC = NA)
    }
    
    tmp_metrics <- rbind(
      ElasticNet   = metrics_elastic,
      GLM          = metrics_glm,
      Lasso        = metrics_lasso,
      Ridge        = metrics_ridge,
      NaiveBayes   = metrics_nb,
      KNN          = metrics_knn2,
      NNET         = metrics_nnet,
      RandomForest = metrics_rf,
      SVM          = metrics_svm2,
      PLS          = metrics_pls
    )
    
    # Store results in the list
    res_list[[length(res_list) + 1]] <- tmp_metrics
    
    models_list[[length(models_list) + 1]] <- list(
      GLM          = classifier_glm,
      KNN          = classifier_knn2,
      SVM          = classifier_svm2,
      NaiveBayes   = classifier_nb,
      RandomForest = classifier_rf,
      NNET         = classifier_nnet,
      PLS          = classifier_pls,
      Ridge        = if (n_features > 1) classifier_ridge else NULL,
      Lasso        = if (n_features > 1) classifier_lasso else NULL,
      ElasticNet   = if (n_features > 1) classifier_elastic else NULL
    )
}
names(models_list) <- fs_names  

saveRDS(models_list, "all_trained_models.rds")

# save the model perfromances to apply to external validation later 
saveRDS(features_select, "features_select.rds")
saveRDS(r_train_mean, "r_train_mean.rds")
saveRDS(r_train_std,  "r_train_std.rds")
saveRDS(uni_LR_variables, "uni_LR_variables.rds")
saveRDS(prin_comp, "prin_comp.rds")   # needed for the pca arm
saveRDS(reproducible_feats, "reproducible_feats.rds")


names(res_list) <- fs_names
```

```{r}

# load saaved trained internal models
models_list       <- readRDS("all_trained_models.rds")
features_select   <- readRDS("features_select.rds")
r_train_mean      <- readRDS("r_train_mean.rds")
r_train_std       <- readRDS("r_train_std.rds")
uni_LR_variables  <- readRDS("uni_LR_variables.rds")
prin_comp         <- readRDS("prin_comp.rds")

fs_names <- c("p.vars","s.vars","k.vars","mim.vars","Lasso.vars",
              "E.Net.vars","bor.vars","rfe.vars","pca")

# Load external cohort 
ext <- read.csv("FINAL_DELTA_ABS_CONCATENATED.csv")
names(ext) <- trimws(names(ext))
names(ext) <- gsub("_(abs)_", "_", names(ext))

# reproducible_feats + outcome column must already match training set columns
ext <- ext[, c("Patient_Num", "His", intersect(reproducible_feats, names(ext)))]

# scale() matches by position, not by name - fail loudly if the columns have
# drifted rather than silently applying the wrong means
stopifnot(identical(names(ext)[-(1:2)], names(r_train_mean)))

# Scale using internal train mean/sd 
ext_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(ext[, 3:ncol(ext)],
                                   center = r_train_mean, scale = r_train_std))
names(ext_scaled) <- make.names(names(ext_scaled))

# Restrict to univariate-significant vars (same step as filt_rad_val) 
ext_uniLR <- as.data.frame(ext_scaled[, uni_LR_variables, drop = FALSE])

ext_His <- factor(ifelse(ext$His == "R", 1,
                  ifelse(ext$His == "NR", 0, NA)),
                  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Neg","Pos"))

#Store AUC results 
auc_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(fs_names), ncol = 10,
                      dimnames = list(fs_names,
                                      c("GLM","KNN","SVM","NaiveBayes","RandomForest",
                                        "NNET","PLS","Ridge","Lasso","ElasticNet")))

for (fs in fs_names) {

  if (fs == "pca") {
    ext_input <- as.data.frame(predict(prin_comp, newdata = ext_scaled))
    ext_input <- ext_input[, 1:8]   # same number of PCs kept as training
  } else {
    vars <- features_select[[which(fs_names == fs)]]
    vars <- intersect(vars, names(ext_uniLR))  # guard against any column mismatch
    ext_input <- ext_uniLR[, vars, drop = FALSE]
  }

  mods <- models_list[[fs]]

  for (mod_name in names(mods)) {
    mdl <- mods[[mod_name]]
    if (is.null(mdl)) next   

    prob <- tryCatch(
      predict(mdl, newdata = ext_input, type = "prob")[, "Pos"],
      error = function(e) NA
    )

    if (all(is.na(prob))) next

    roc_obj <- tryCatch(
      pROC::roc(response = ext_His, predictor = prob,
                levels = c("Neg","Pos"), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
      auc_matrix[fs, mod_name] <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
    }
  }
}

auc_matrix
write.csv(auc_matrix, "external_AUC_all_combos.csv")
```

```{r}
maxstat_res <- maxstat.test(
  Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ Predicted_Prob,
  data    = ext_surv,
  smethod = "LogRank",
  pmethod = "exactGauss"
)

print(maxstat_res)

cutpoint <- as.numeric(maxstat_res$estimate)
message("\nOptimal cutpoint:", signif(cutpoint, 4), "\n")
message("Corrected p-value:", signif(maxstat_res$p.value, 4), "\n")

ext_surv$Predicted_Class_max <- factor(
  ifelse(ext_surv$Predicted_Prob > cutpoint, "Pos", "Neg"),
  levels = c("Neg", "Pos")
)

split_tab <- table(ext_surv$Predicted_Class_max)
message ("\nMaxstat cutpoint split:\n"); print(split_tab)


if (length(split_tab) < 2 || any(split_tab == 0)) {
  stop("Maxstat produced a single-group split — no valid dichotomisation.")
}

group_var  <- "Predicted_Class_max"
km_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~", group_var))
```

```{r}
# load internal trained models
models_list        <- readRDS("all_trained_models.rds")

r_train_std        <- readRDS("r_train_std.rds")
uni_LR_variables   <- readRDS("uni_LR_variables.rds")

features_select    <- readRDS("features_select.rds")
reproducible_feats <- readRDS("reproducible_feats.rds")

# Load clinical data
crf <- read.csv("CRF-LCIO-UPDATES.csv")

# Extract Patient_Num
crf$Patient_Num <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", crf$Study.ID))

# Create binary PD-L1 column (1 = Pos, 0 = Neg)
crf$PDL1_Binary <- ifelse(crf$PD.L1 %in% c("Strongly Positive", "Weakly Positive", "1"), 1,
                   ifelse(crf$PD.L1 == "0", 0, NA))

#  drop missing tests
pdl1_data <- crf[!is.na(crf$PDL1_Binary), c("Patient_Num", "PDL1_Binary")]


ext <- read.csv("FINAL_DELTA_ABS_CONCATENATED.csv")
names(ext) <- trimws(names(ext))
names(ext) <- gsub("_(abs)_", "_", names(ext))

# Merge the clean PD-L1 status into the external cohort
ext <- merge(ext, pdl1_data, by = "Patient_Num")

overlap <- intersect(reproducible_feats, names(ext))
message(glue("Feature overlap: {length(overlap)} of {length(reproducible_feats)} reproducible_feats found in ext"))

# Defensive guard so you get a clear error instead of the "undefined columns" crash
if (length(overlap) == 0) stop("No overlapping features found — check naming convention again.")

ext <- ext[, c("Patient_Num", "PDL1_Binary", overlap)]

# Convert to standard Neg/Pos 
ext_PDL1 <- factor(ext$PDL1_Binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Neg", "Pos"))

# scale
stopifnot(identical(names(ext)[-(1:2)], names(r_train_mean)))

# Scale features using trained models
ext_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(ext[, 3:ncol(ext)],
                                   center = r_train_mean, scale = r_train_std))
names(ext_scaled) <- make.names(names(ext_scaled))
ext_uniLR <- as.data.frame(ext_scaled[, uni_LR_variables, drop = FALSE])


auc_matrix_pdl1 <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(fs_names), ncol = 10,
                      dimnames = list(fs_names,

                                        "NNET","PLS","Ridge","Lasso","ElasticNet")))

for (fs in fs_names) {

  if (fs == "pca") {
    ext_input <- as.data.frame(predict(prin_comp, newdata = ext_scaled))[, 1:8]
  } else {
    vars <- intersect(features_select[[which(fs_names == fs)]], names(ext_uniLR))
    ext_input <- ext_uniLR[, vars, drop = FALSE]
  }

  mods <- models_list[[fs]]

  for (mod_name in names(mods)) {
    mdl <- mods[[mod_name]]
    if (is.null(mdl)) next 

    prob <- tryCatch(
      predict(mdl, newdata = ext_input, type = "prob")[, "Pos"],
      error = function(e) NA
    )
    if (all(is.na(prob))) next

    # Grade the model against PDL1

      pROC::roc(response = ext_PDL1, predictor = prob,
                levels = c("Neg","Pos"), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
      auc_matrix_pdl1[fs, mod_name] <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
    }
  }
}

# Save results
```

```{r}


# 1. LOAD RAW COMBINED PRE+POST EXTRACTION (this csv contains the feature values of pre and post scans)

raw <- read.csv("outputpdl1.csv", check.names = TRUE)
 
raw <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    Patient_Num = as.numeric(str_extract(ID, "(?<=patient_)\\d+")),
    Timepoint   = str_extract(ID, "pre|post"),
    MaskFile    = basename(Mask)
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("Mp|Ms", MaskFile))   # drop Mp/Ms rows, keep only main mask
 

# 2. PULL OUT THE 3 TARGET FEATURES FROM GRAPH PRIOR

target_features_raw <- c(
  "square_glrlm_RunPercentage",
  "square_gldm_LargeDependenceLowGrayLevelEmphasis",
  "wavelet.LLL_firstorder_90Percentile"
)
 
raw_sub <- raw %>%
  select(Patient_Num, Timepoint, all_of(target_features_raw))
 

wide_raw <- raw_sub %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Patient_Num,
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = all_of(target_features_raw),
    names_sep = "_"
  )
 

# 4. ATTACH RESPONSE GROUP 

post_clean <- read.csv("Fu1_PD-L1_POST_CONCATENATED.csv")
his_lookup <- post_clean %>% select(Patient_Num, His)
 
wide_raw <- wide_raw %>%
  left_join(his_lookup, by = "Patient_Num") %>%
  mutate(His = ifelse(His == "R", "Responder",
                ifelse(His == "NR", "Non-Responder", NA))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(His))
 

# 5. COMPUTE RAW SIGNED CHANGE (POST - PRE) PER PATIENT FOR ABSOLUTE
#    

raw_change <- wide_raw %>%
  mutate(
    square_gldm_LargeDependenceLowGrayLevelEmphasis_change =
      square_gldm_LargeDependenceLowGrayLevelEmphasis_post - square_gldm_LargeDependenceLowGrayLevelEmphasis_pre,
    square_glrlm_RunPercentage_change =
      square_glrlm_RunPercentage_post - square_glrlm_RunPercentage_pre,
    wavelet.LLL_firstorder_90Percentile_change =
      wavelet.LLL_firstorder_90Percentile_post - wavelet.LLL_firstorder_90Percentile_pre
  )
 
#  COMPUTE MEAN CHANGE PER FEATURE/GROUP


mean_change <- raw_change %>%
  select(Patient_Num, His, ends_with("_change")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_change"),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Change"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Feature = gsub("_change$", "", Feature)) %>%
  group_by(Feature, His) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Change = mean(Change, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = sd(Change, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
print(mean_change)
 

wrap_at_underscore <- function(x, width = 18) {
  sapply(x, function(s) {
    parts <- strsplit(s, "_")[[1]]
    out <- character(0)
    line <- ""
    for (p in parts) {
      candidate <- if (line == "") p else paste0(line, "_", p)
      if (nchar(candidate) > width && line != "") {
        out <- c(out, line)
        line <- p
      } else {
        line <- candidate
      }
    }
    out <- c(out, line)
    paste(out, collapse = "\n")
  })
}
 
mean_change <- mean_change %>%
  mutate(Feature_label = wrap_at_underscore(Feature, width = 18))
 

# 8. PLOT MEAN SIGNED CHANGE 
p_change <- ggplot(mean_change, aes(x = His, y = Mean_Change, fill = His)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Change - SE, ymax = Mean_Change + SE), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature_label, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#00BFC4", "Non-Responder" = "#F8766D")) +
  labs(title = "Mean Change (Post vs Pre)",
       subtitle = "Top NNET (k.vars) Features",
       x = "Response Group", y = "Mean Change (raw feature units)", fill = "Response Group") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1, size = 8),
  
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold", lineheight = 0.8, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 6, b = 6)),
    
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
  )
 
print(p_change)
 

ggsave("mean_signedChange_kvars_nnet_raw.png", plot = p_change, width = 14, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 1. RETRIEVE chosen MODEL & DATA

pfun <- function(object, newdata) {
  
  predict(object, newdata = newdata, type = "prob")[, "Pos"]
}


# CALCULATE SHAP VALUES


set.seed(500)
message("Calculating SHAP values for the external cohort.")

shap_values <- fastshap::explain(
  chosen_model, 
  X = ext_input_chosen, 
  pred_wrapper = pfun, 
  nsim = 100, 
  adjust = TRUE
)


# get shap values

sv <- shapviz(shap_values, X = ext_input_chosen)

# Generate the global SHAP plot
shap_plot <- sv_importance(sv, kind = "bee") + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
  labs(
    title = paste("SHAP Summary Plot:", chosen_fs, "x", chosen_mod),
    subtitle = "External Validation Cohort — Delta Absolute",
    x = "SHAP Value (Impact on Prediction)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(shap_plot)


ggsave("SHAP_Summary_NNET_kvars_DeltaAbsolute.png", plot = shap_plot, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# 95% CI for every AUC (DeLong)
# =========================================================
ci_rows <- list()

for (fs in fs_names) {
  if (fs == "pca") {
    ext_input <- as.data.frame(predict(prin_comp, newdata = ext_scaled))[, 1:8]
  } else {
    vars <- intersect(features_select[[which(fs_names == fs)]], names(ext_uniLR))
    ext_input <- ext_uniLR[, vars, drop = FALSE]
  }

  for (mod_name in names(models_list[[fs]])) {
    mdl <- models_list[[fs]][[mod_name]]
    if (is.null(mdl)) next

    prob <- tryCatch(predict(mdl, newdata = ext_input, type = "prob")[, "Pos"],
                     error = function(e) NA)
    if (all(is.na(prob))) next

    r <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(ext_His, prob, levels = c("Neg","Pos"),
                            direction = "<", quiet = TRUE),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(r)) next

    ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(r))
    ci_rows[[length(ci_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      FeatureSet = fs, Model = mod_name,
      AUC = round(ci[2], 3), Lower = round(ci[1], 3), Upper = round(ci[3], 3)
    )
  }
}

ci_table <- do.call(rbind, ci_rows)
ci_table <- ci_table[order(-ci_table$AUC), ]

# top result, formatted for the thesis
cat(sprintf("\nBest: %s x %s — AUC %.2f (95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)\n\n",
            ci_table$FeatureSet[1], ci_table$Model[1],
            ci_table$AUC[1], ci_table$Lower[1], ci_table$Upper[1]))

print(head(ci_table, 10))
write.csv(ci_table, "AUC_with_CI.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
